scope: Official Android ONNX Runtime path on CPUExecutionProvider only.

prompt.normalization: If present, remove exactly one final LF; otherwise direct SentencePiece encoding with no text normalization. The frozen file has no final LF.

generation.sampling: official fixed sampled-frame graph and its embedded constants
generation.output: official example mono average of the native two codec channels, PCM16 WAV at 48000 Hz

benchmark.process: One fresh app process creates four sessions and runs one first plus three warm end-to-end generations.
benchmark.session_setup: Elapsed monotonic time to create all four ORT sessions, including graph load and optimization; file staging and app startup are excluded.
benchmark.end_to_end: Elapsed monotonic time from request-row construction through prefill, autoregressive generation, full codec decode, and WAV write.
benchmark.rtf: end_to_end_ms divided by decoded audio duration_ms.
benchmark.first_audio: Elapsed from generation start until full codec decode returns the first PCM buffer. The official Android example is non-streaming, so this is not streaming time-to-first-chunk.
benchmark.threads: Configured ORT pools plus total process Threads sampled from /proc/self/status every 50 ms.
benchmark.memory: Process VmHWM plus sampled VmRSS every 50 ms and Debug.getPss every 500 ms. These are process-wide, not component-isolated allocations.

profiling.claim_boundary: ORT JSON profiles establish provider assignment and instrumented operator timing. They are not HTP evidence and their overhead is excluded from benchmark latency.

device_safety.adb: Windows adb.exe with ADB_LIBUSB=1 and the lock file descriptor closed in every child
device_safety.staging: Unique app-internal files directory populated through run-as/exec-out, compatible with Android 15 scoped storage
device_safety.cleanup: Pull evidence, delete unique internal stage, verify absence, uninstall test APK, and release lock
